cover: Maritime attacks rattle Hormuz as Poland descends into constitutional turmoil
cover_scene: A naval patrol boat speeds past a commercial tanker in a narrow waterway beneath a dramatic sunset while smoke rises on distant shores.

slides.scene: A commercial oil tanker sails through the narrow Strait of Hormuz flanked by rocky coastlines under a hazy orange sky, with small vessels visible nearby.
slides.headline: Commercial Tanker Attacked in Strait of Hormuz
slides.body: A commercial tanker carrying 27 Indian crew members was attacked in the vital Strait of Hormuz. The incident escalates maritime security threats across the global energy passage, while Tehran warned it will condition reopening the transit route on diplomatic terms with Washington.

slides.scene: Heavily equipped riot police form a defensive perimeter outside a classical European constitutional court building illuminated by emergency vehicle lights.
slides.headline: Poland Deploys Riot Police in Court Standoff
slides.body: Polish authorities deployed riot police to the Constitutional Tribunal in Warsaw following an overnight takeover of the building. The showdown erupted after President Andrzej Duda accused Prime Minister Donald Tusk's administration of orchestrating an illegal institutional coup amid deep political fissures.

slides.scene: Camouflaged military operators stand in a row beside Patriot missile battery launchers mounted on heavy transport trucks in a secure field.
slides.headline: US Approves $2.1 Billion Patriot Interceptors Sale
slides.body: The United States cleared a $2.1 billion foreign military sale supplying 500 Patriot missile interceptors to Ukraine. The massive munition transfer aims to counter persistent Russian aerial barrages against Ukrainian civilian infrastructure, heading next to Congress for standard review.

slides.scene: An open-air stadium glowing under floodlights in Dakar with energetic crowds celebrating the lighting of a youth athletic torch against an evening sky.
slides.headline: Senegal Launches Africa's First Olympic Competition
slides.body: Senegal officially opened the Youth Olympic Games in Dakar, marking the first time any Olympic sporting event is hosted on the African continent. The historic multisport tournament gathers elite young global competitors to challenge traditional boundaries in international athletics.
